body: Please run `pm2 startup` without any other arguments and run the said command, we tested on centos 7 and it worked.
It didn't work with pm2 v2.2.2, same error. 2.1.4 again runs just fine.
If you don't have any error to show me i can't really help you, it was working great under both centos 6 & 7 for us.

The error is at the end of the log i posted.
```
systemd[1]: [/etc/systemd/system/pm2.service:19] Unknown lvalue 'ExecStopPre' in section 'Service'
```
Anyway, as I said, I've got it working by downgrading. Just wanted to help with this issue.
I'm sleepy sorry i didn't saw the errors logs, we will investigate
